description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of several language models across six categories: “BT-EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”. The categories are displayed on the horizontal axis, labeled with text, and appear to be in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents a value ranging from 0 to 1, labeled as “Probability”, with tick labels at intervals of 0.10. Each category has a set of three vertically oriented bars, representing the performance of “RedWhale (our)” in dark blue, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” in light blue, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” in light gray. Within each category, the bars are grouped side-by-side. For example, in the “BT-EVAL” category, “RedWhale (our)” has a value of approximately 0.42, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” has a value of 0.52, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” has a value of 0.56. The tallest bar across all categories is for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” in the “KoBEST-BQ” category, with a value of 0.79, while the shortest bar is for “RedWhale (our)” in the “AVG” category, with a value of 0.59. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
